description: Create house.food, the only category with an expiry date.
rationale: Food is the one thing in the house that stops being an asset on a known date. That date is required, and it is what 0097 deletes on.

intents.comment: Detail for an item of category food. One row per house.item row; the brand is on house.item.

columns.name: expiry_date
columns.comment: Last day it should be eaten. Required: food with no expiry is food nobody can clear out.

columns.name: net_weight
columns.comment: Net quantity in the package, in weight_unit.

columns.name: weight_unit
columns.comment: Unit net_weight is stated in. Stored rather than normalised to grams, because the label is what anyone checks against.

columns.name: opened
columns.comment: Whether the package has been opened, which shortens how long it really lasts.

intents.name: food_expiry_date_idx
intents.comment: What expires next, which is the only question anybody asks this table.

intents.name: food_kind_idx
intents.comment: How much rice is in the house.
